bytecode: Verified the branch destinations, saved request, page-finished hook, WebView loader, and Android startActivity dispatch of all four rebuilt APKs. Unchanged bundle definitions checked by canonical DEX comparison.

android_17.runtime: The share-redirect and URL test suites ran on Android ART, loading the runtime classes from the actual six-patch 3.84.22 output first.

full_app_tap_test.environment: API 37 x86_64 emulator using software CPU emulation
full_app_tap_test.result: Installed the rebuilt six-patch APK and Instagram 456.0.0.53.78. When the genuine arm64 Berry APK was launched under x86 translation, the process exited with SIGILL before the WebView link could be tapped.

emulator_post_handoff.source: Emulator-only Berry APK with the same five DEX files and resources as the release build, with two test x86_64 native libraries added for the x86 emulator.
emulator_post_handoff.preconditions: Enabled the installed Instagram link activities on the disposable emulator and selected instagram.com and www.instagram.com as supported domains. On a fresh install the two Instagram link activities were disabled and a tap remained in Berry.
emulator_post_handoff.test: Physically tapped the post anchor in the Berry WebView on a local test page. ActivityTaskManager reported ACTION_VIEW with HTTPS data, originating from Berry and targeting com.instagram.android/com.instagram.url.UrlHandlerActivity, result code 0. Post content over the internet was not tested.
